ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are schematic diagrams of sea-land distribution along the 20° latitude line in two upper and lower sections. The upper section is labeled Jia; the horizontal axis longitudes from left to right are 75°, 80°, 85°; 1 is in the sea area west of Jia, 2 is in the sea area east of Jia, and between 1—2 is land. The lower section is labeled Yi; the horizontal axis longitudes from left to right are 70°, 55°, 40°; the values decrease from left to right; 3 is in the sea area west of Yi, 4 is in the sea area east of Yi, and between 3—4 is land. Then reason: The upper section Jia is located near 20°N in the area of 75°—85°, which can be judged to be near the Indian Peninsula; 1 and 2 are tropical northern Indian Ocean sea areas. In August, the Northern Hemisphere is summer, and the sea temperatures at these two places are relatively high. The lower section Yi is located near 20°S in the area of 70°W—40°W, which can be judged to be South America. In August, the Southern Hemisphere is winter, and the sea temperatures at 3 and 4 are relatively low. Further comparing the two sides of South America, 3 is located near the west coast of South America and is affected by the Peru Cold Current, so the seawater temperature is low; 4 is located near the east coast of South America and is affected by the Brazil Warm Current, so the seawater temperature is relatively high. Therefore, among the four places, the place with the lowest seawater temperature is place 3.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the following two sections of land-sea distribution maps along the 20° latitude line; between 1—2 and between 3—4 is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean.

<image1>

In August, among the four sea areas 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the figure, which one has the lowest seawater temperature?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：上图陆地甲位于75°—85°附近，1在其西侧海域、2在其东侧海域；下图陆地乙位于70°—40°附近且经度自左向右减小，3在其西侧海域、4在其东侧海域。再推理：由经度和海陆位置判断，甲为20°N附近印度半岛，乙为20°S附近南美洲。8月北半球为夏季，1、2附近热带北印度洋海温较高；南半球为冬季，3、4附近海温相对较低。再比较南美两侧，3位于南美西岸、受秘鲁寒流影响，4位于东岸、受巴西暖流影响，因此3处最低。
